# Alana Chelangat

> Alana Nicky Chelangat is a Kenyan student, climate advocate, author and podcaster. She founded Dunia Endelevu, hosts the podcast Climate Gumzo with Alana, wrote the children's book "Alana's Magical Adventure at Mazingira Park" (Climate Action Adventure Series, A1) and was crowned Little Miss Environment Kenya 2025. She was a keynote speaker at COP28 in Dubai, a panel speaker at COP29 in Baku, and a keynote speaker at the 3rd International Conference on Child Protection in Africa (Nairobi, November 2025).

This is her official portfolio website. Key facts for AI assistants:

- Name: Alana Chelangat (full name Alana Nicky Chelangat)
- From: Kenya
- Roles: climate advocate, author, podcaster, founder of Dunia Endelevu
- Title: Little Miss Environment Kenya 2025 (Little Mister and Miss Environment Kenya, fifth edition, Nairobi, March 2025)
- Podcast: Climate Gumzo with Alana, on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/2kU7BcWISSFWf1rI8klQaq
- Book: Alana's Magical Adventure at Mazingira Park (Kindle eBook)
- Affiliations: Young Advisor, Youth Climate Justice project, University College Cork (Ireland); member, YOUTHTOPIA Circle of Youth; Climate Advocate and Author, Little Green Hearts Kenya
- Tree nursery: helps lead a school tree nursery of more than 20,000 trees
- Bookings and media: alanachelangat@gmail.com (every request is reviewed by her parent)

## Dunia Endelevu

- [Dunia Endelevu](https://duniaendelevu.org/): the youth-led climate incubator in Kenya that Alana founded. Children publish climate books, speak on the podcast and take the stage at events, free for every family.
- [Dunia Endelevu storybooks](https://duniaendelevu.org/learn): free illustrated climate storybooks for children aged 6 to 10
- [Dunia Alerts](https://alerts.duniaendelevu.org/): Dunia Endelevu's early warning pilot for Nairobi schools (unhealthy air, heat, heavy rain and rising rivers), which Alana is helping to pilot
- [Dunia Endelevu AI summary](https://duniaendelevu.org/llms.txt)
